etymologies.etymologyHTML: From Latin contribūtus, perfect passive participle of contribuō (“I bring together; I unite”), from con- (“together”) +‎ tribuō (“I bestow”), from tribus (“tribe”), derived from trēs (“three”), from Proto-Italic *trēs, from Proto-Indo-European *tréyes.

definitions.definition: (transitive, intransitive) To give something that is or becomes part of a larger whole.
